mapper.sql: select cs.id, cs.customer_id, cs.sku_id, cs.alias, cs.customer_code, cs.unit, cs.min_order_qty, cs.order_step, cs.is_follow_default, cs.source_template_id, cs.status, cs.created_at, cs.updated_at, sku.name as sku_name, sku.code as sku_code, sku.spec_name as sku_spec_name, sku.unit as sku_unit, sku.is_weighted as sku_is_weighted, sku.sale_price as sku_sale_price, sku.category_id as sku_category_id, sku.mnemonic_code as sku_mnemonic_code, category.name as category_name from customers_sku cs left join t_product_sku sku on cs.sku_id = sku.id left join t_product_category category on sku.category_id = category.id
mapper.select: where cs.customer_id = #{customerId} and cs.status = 1 and ( sku.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sku.mnemonic_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cs.alias like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cs.customer_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sku.id in (select sku_id from product_alias where alias like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or sku.id in (select sku_id from customer_sku_mapping where customer_id = #{customerId} and customer_alias like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) order by (cs.customer_id = #{customerId} and sku.id in (select sku_id from customer_sku_mapping where customer_id = #{customerId} and customer_alias like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))) desc, (sku.id in (select sku_id from product_alias where alias like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))) desc, cs.created_at desc
